title: Aussie Beef Roast
description: A classic roasted beef dish from Australia, tender and flavorful. Perfect for special occasions or Sunday dinner.

ingredients.name: Australian beef roast
ingredients.notes: Choose a high-quality cut for the best results

ingredients.name: lovely roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: Choose your favorite vegetables, such as carrots, potatoes, and onions

ingredients.name: a pinch of salt
ingredients.notes: Use a flaky sea salt for added flavor

instructions: Season the beef roast with salt and pepper.
Heat a large oven-safe pan over high heat. Add the beef roast and sear until browned on all sides.
Transfer the pan to the preheated oven and roast for 20 minutes.
Reduce the oven temperature to 180°C (350°F) and continue roasting for an additional 45 minutes, or until the beef reaches your desired level of doneness.
While the beef is cooking, prepare your roasted vegetables by tossing them with a bit of oil and seasoning with salt and pepper.
After the beef has roasted for 20 minutes, add the vegetables to the pan and continue roasting for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Remove the pan from the oven and let the beef rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving.
Serve the beef roast with the roasted vegetables and your choice of sides, such as mashed potatoes or a salad.
